qrCode.title: QR code generator
qrCode.description: Generate QR codes in your browser and download them as PNG or SVG.
qrCode.heading: QR code generator
qrCode.introduction: Turn a link or some text into a QR code. Everything is generated in your browser; your input is not uploaded or saved.
qrCode.inputHint: Use a full URL, including https://, for a website. Up to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes; spaces and line breaks are preserved.
qrCode.emptyPreview: Your QR code will appear here.
qrCode.downloadHint: Black on white, with a scan-safe border. PNG for sharing; SVG for printing at any size.
qrCode.emptyMessage: Enter text or a URL to get started.
qrCode.tooLongMessage: This text is too long. Shorten it to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes or fewer.
qrCode.errorMessage: The QR code could not be generated. Try changing the text or reloading the page.
qrCode.loadErrorMessage: The QR generator could not load. Reload the page to try again.
qrCode.noScriptMessage: Enable JavaScript to generate QR codes. Your input stays in your browser.
